summary.whatChanges: Test-only cleanup fixes in the upgrade package's React test harness: the optimistic-update fixture teardown becomes an async disposable that waits for in-flight mutations to settle before resetting state and unmounting, and the shared test helper clears the module-scoped queryClient on every renderApp call.
behaviorChanges: Fixture teardown now awaits pending mutations (vi.waitFor on queryClient.isMutating() === 0) before resetting fixture state and unmounting
Teardown uses `await using` with makeAsyncResource instead of synchronous `using`/makeResource
Each renderApp call starts with a cleared queryClient, discarding cache left by a prior run or vitest retry
risks: vi.waitFor in teardown can time out or stall if a mutation never settles, masking or delaying the real test failure
Clearing the shared queryClient on every render breaks any test relying on cache persistence across multiple renders in one test
Relies on `await using` / async disposable support in the test runtime and on makeAsyncResource being exported from unstable-core-do-not-import
